test_bernoulli_distribution_properties: test the Bernoulli distribution properties including logits, probs, event_shape, and batch_shape
test_bernoulli_sample_values: test Bernoulli sample and sample_and_log_prob methods verifying samples are binary with correct mean and stddev
test_bernoulli_probability_methods: test Bernoulli prob, log_prob, cdf, log_cdf, survival_function, and log_survival_function methods with various value shapes
test_bernoulli_statistical_methods: test Bernoulli entropy, mode, mean, variance, and stddev statistical methods
test_bernoulli_divergence: test Bernoulli kl_divergence and cross_entropy between two distributions in distrax and TFP modes
